question: How should kuśa grasses representing the tattvas be placed?
premises: Kuśa grasses correspond to the thirty-six tattvas.
They are arranged in groups beginning with three.
The officiant should place them ritually.
inference: Kuśa grasses representing up to the thirty-six tattvas should be placed in sets beginning with three.
uncertainties: The exact grouping implied by tryādīn is not fully specified.
plain_english: One should then place kuśa grasses representing up to the thirty-six tattvas, in groups beginning with three.
